name: British English Convert
description: Converts American English spellings to British English in code comments and strings
content:
#!/bin/bash
# Convert American English to British English in edited files
FILE="$TOOL_INPUT_FILE_PATH"
if [[ -f "$FILE" ]]; then
  sed -i '' 's/color/colour/g; s/Color/Colour/g' "$FILE" 2>/dev/null
  sed -i '' 's/organize/organise/g; s/Organize/Organise/g' "$FILE" 2>/dev/null
  sed -i '' 's/initialize/initialise/g; s/Initialize/Initialise/g' "$FILE" 2>/dev/null
fi
exit 0
